widgets.name: SvgPictureAsset
widgets.description: A widget that will parse SVG data for rendering on screen.

properties.name: matchTextDirection
properties.description: If true, will horizontally flip the picture in [TextDirection.rtl] contexts.

properties.name: width
properties.description: If specified, the width to use for the SVG.  If unspecified, the SVG will take the width of its parent.

properties.name: height
properties.description: If specified, the height to use for the SVG.  If unspecified, the SVG will take the height of its parent.

properties.name: fit
properties.description: How to inscribe the picture into the space allocated during layout. The default is [BoxFit.contain].

properties.name: alignment
properties.description: How to align the picture within its parent widget.

properties.name: allowDrawingOutsideViewBox
properties.description: If true, will allow the SVG to be drawn outside of the clip boundary of its viewBox.

properties.name: placeholderBuilder
properties.description: The placeholder to use while fetching, decoding, and parsing the SVG data.

properties.name: semanticsLabel
properties.description: The [Semantics.label] for this picture.

properties.name: excludeFromSemantics
properties.description: Whether to exclude this picture from semantics.

properties.name: clipBehavior
properties.description: The content will be clipped (or not) according to this option.

properties.name: errorBuilder
properties.description: Widget displayed while the target image failed loading.

properties.name: imageBuilder
properties.description: A builder that wraps the successfully loaded SVG widget.

properties.name: renderingStrategy
properties.description: Widget rendering strategy used to balance flexibility and performance.

properties.name: analyticsId
properties.description: Optional identifier for this widget occurrence.
